subject.title: Add gated Claw publication and validation

question: Should ClawHub adopt the RFC #27 Claw package family now, and if so must publication and read gating land atomically before any deployment may enable `CLAWHUB_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS`?
rationale: This introduces a new persistent package family, environment-controlled product surface, dependencies, and public registry contract while the RFC and companion schema/read PRs remain open; implementation review cannot decide that permanent product boundary.

options.title: Approve coordinated experimental stack
options.body: Approve the Claw family but require the schema, publication, read-hiding, serializer filtering, and lifecycle proof to land before enabling the flag anywhere.

options.title: Keep the RFC exploratory
options.body: Leave this PR draft until maintainers narrow or approve the manifest, persistence, and registry responsibilities in the RFC.

options.title: Reject registry-owned Claws
options.body: Close the stack if complete-agent packaging should remain outside ClawHub's persistent package and API model.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated experimental stack
recommendation.body: Approve the Claw family but require the schema, publication, read-hiding, serializer filtering, and lifecycle proof to land before enabling the flag anywhere.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the RFC and coordinated implementation stack and is the best available contact to present the intended boundary for maintainer approval.
